title: Scope and minimum dimensions of special moment frame columns
statement: The requirements of rule 8.3.5.1 shall apply to columns and other frame members serving to resist earthquake forces and having a factored axial force exceeding 0.1 × Ag × f'c. The shortest cross-sectional dimension of a frame member subject to rule 8.3.5.1 shall not be less than 300 mm. The ratio of the shortest cross-sectional dimension to the perpendicular dimension of a frame member subject to rule 8.3.5.1 shall not be less than 0.4.
scope_note: Covers clause (a): which columns the section applies to, and their minimum cross-sectional dimensions.
